title.zh: 将罗哈斯市米利比利村学校更名为唐·曼努埃尔·阿纳尔多纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City to Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City to Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City thành Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City เป็น Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City menjadi Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City menjadi Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3504_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Milibili Barrio School in Roxas City is hereby changed to Don Manuel Arnaldo Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
